newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Comsys rises on earnings outlook.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Comsys rises on earnings outlook.

text.p: Nippon Comsys Corp shares climbed to a new high for the current calendar year on Friday morning, strengthened by a bright earnings forecast, brokers said.
As of 0103 GMT, the shares in the telecommunications engineering company had jumped 40 yen to 1,560.
On Thursday, the firm said its parent current profit was due to rise to 15.10 billion in the year to March 31, 1998 from 13.84 billion the previous year.
On a group basis, current profit is seen rising to 15.20 billion yen from 14.10 billion.
